name: project-killchain-hub
description: Project KillChain Hub — open-source cybersecurity knowledge and IOC platform for Red Team and Blue Team practitioners.
author: CyDefOps

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @pkc/api" "npm run dev -w @pkc/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @pkc/api && npm run build -w @pkc/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @pkc/api && npm run test -w @pkc/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @pkc/api && npm run typecheck -w @pkc/web
